en: Scientist
Oh, good, I caught you! Our president just gave you a PokéNav, didn't he? It's missing something important.
Let me add Match Call to it. With Match Call, you can talk to the people you've registered, wherever they are.
There! I've put in your mother's number, and our president's. Open the PokéNav from your menu to try it.
Trainers you meet on the road may want to swap numbers too. They'll call you when they want a rematch!
Team Aqua Grunt
Outta my way! Coming through!
Devon Employee
W-wait! Stop, thief! Give those back! Those goods belong to Devon!
Devon Employee
You there! You're a trainer, aren't you? That was Team Aqua! They snatched a package of our parts right out of my hands!
The thief ran off east, toward Rusturf Tunnel. Please, you have to get the Devon Goods back!
The thief went east, into Rusturf Tunnel. Please hurry! Those parts are very important!
Devon Employee
Ah! You got the Devon Goods back from that thief! You're amazing! Thank you, thank you!
Here, please take this. It's a Great Ball, one of our very own!
Oh, and our president would like to thank you himself. Please, come with me!
{rival}
Ready for that battle now, {player}?
{rival}
{player}! I didn't expect to see you in Rustboro. Wait, is that a PokéNav? Devon only just made those!
Here, let's register each other. That way we can talk whenever we want!
So... how strong have you got since Route 103? Want to find out?
Battle {rival}?
All right! Don't hold back, now!
You've been training hard, haven't you? I'll have to work twice as hard to keep up!
Oh, OK. Come and find me when you're ready. I'll be right here!
Hey, have you heard of Mr. Briney? He's an old sailor who lives by the beach on Route 104.
They say he'll take people across the sea in his boat. Dewford Town's just a short sail away!
Devon's building is the tallest in town. They say its president collects rare stones.
Did you see that fellow in the striped shirt? He ran past me so fast, my hat nearly blew off!
The tunnel east of town goes nowhere. They stopped digging halfway because of the Pokémon living there.
I saw old Mr. Briney hurrying home with his Wingull. He looked so happy!
The Gym Leader here is a teacher at the school, too. Clever and strong. Quite the combination!
Oh, that's a Stone Badge! You beat Roxanne? You'll go far, I'm sure of it.
